names.en: Heaven Always Leaves A Way Out For People

summary.text: Heaven Always Leaves A Way Out For People is an immortal killer move named when Shen Shang uses it.

claims.text: Shen Shang shouts that he succeeded and that his killer move is complete. He puts its success rate at eighty percent. The move was incomplete before because it lacked heaven path results, but the lacking part is not the crucial core. Fang Yuan says to protect Shen Shang while he attempts it. Amid Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s offense, Shen Shang activates heaven always leaves a way out for people and creates a narrow path. The path is long and winding, and it cannot compare to luck changing golden light path. It pierces through the Door of Life and Death, and the immortals see the vague scene of the outside world at the end of the path. Shen Shang calls out that it succeeded. The immortals protect each other as they step on the narrow path and escape. The killer move is unique. Even the Door of Life and Death cannot stop them from escaping. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable does not step out of the Door of Life and Death.
